question: Who led the four-member Indian judo team at the Asian Games 2023 in Hangzhou ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tulika Maan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Tulika Maan** led the Indian judo team at the **Asian Games 2023**, held in Hangzhou, China.
 
• She is a renowned Indian judoka who competes in the **78 kg weight category**.
 
• Tulika Maan has previously represented India in several international competitions, earning medals and recognition for her exceptional skills in judo.
 
• At the Commonwealth Games 2022, she won the **silver medal in the Women’s 78 kg category**, further solidifying her position as one of India’s top judokas.
 
• The Indian judo contingent at the Asian Games 2023 included four members, with Tulika Maan serving as a prominent leader and representative of the team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Avtar Singh**
 
 
• Avtar Singh is an Indian judoka who specializes in the **90 kg weight category**.
 
• He represented India at the **2016 Rio Olympics**, becoming the first Indian judoka to qualify for the Olympics in over a decade.
 
• Avtar Singh has also won medals at the South Asian Games and other international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Indubala Devi Maibam**
 
 
• Indubala Devi Maibam is an Indian judoka who has represented the country in various national and international tournaments.
 
• She competes in the **63 kg weight category**.
 
• While she has shown promise in her performances, she was not the team leader for the Asian Games 2023.
 
 
 
• **Garima Choudhary**
 
 
• Garima Choudhary is a prominent Indian judoka who participated in the **2012 London Olympics**.
 
• She competed in the **63 kg weight category** and has been an inspiration for young judokas in India.
 
• Despite her experience, she was not the leader of the Indian judo team at the Asian Games 2023.
 
 
 
• **About Judo in India**
 
 
• Judo is a modern martial art and combat sport that originated in Japan and has gained significant popularity in India.
 
• India has produced talented judokas who have represented the country on global platforms like the Olympics, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games.
 
• The **Judo Federation of India (JFI)** is the governing body responsible for organizing national competitions and preparing athletes for international events.
